event.title: Record Voter Turnout in Israel Election as Voting Continues
event.canonical_title: Record Voter Turnout in Israel Election as Voting Continues
event.summary: As voting continues in Israel's election, nearly 45% of the electorate had cast their ballots by mid-afternoon, marking the highest turnout since records began in 1973. The election is anticipated to be closely contested, with potential for a stalemate.

key_facts: Almost 45% of voters had voted by 2 p.m.
This is the highest turnout recorded since 1973.
The election is expected to be a close contest.

timeline.title: Israel Faces Political Deadlock Following Record Turnout in Election
timeline.summary: In a highly anticipated election, Israeli voters turned out in record numbers, marking the highest participation in decades. Provisional results indicate a political deadlock, with no clear path to power for either of the main parties, leaving the outcome uncertain.
key_facts: Voter turnout was the highest in decades.
Provisional results show no clear path to power for main parties.
